clips.title: The story
paras: At Shadowfang Keep, Head of Arugal is taken from the mad archmage who commands the worgen. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek it as proof that he has fallen.

Archmage Arugal commands the worgen from Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher gives the order to claim his severed head. The Forsaken see Arugal's fall as a blow against the beasts that hinder Lady Sylvanas's hold over Silverpine. Bringing the head to Dawnweaver proves the archmage's sorcery has been cut from the land.
